rows.en: Spiner?
A high-yield explosive the Terrestrial Defense Force developed. The enemy must've been improving it.
With this, we should be able to destroy the rocks blocking the path.
Use the Spiner?
Meanwhile, Yapool and Ikadevil...
So the heroes are heading this way, are they?
But when they learn that where they're headed is their own graveyard, they'll be quite surprised.
You went so far as to prepare such a place... And what will you have them fight?
The executioner is my mightiest superhuman from another dimension. It'll send them to hell in a flash.
Oh? So that superhuman is finally complete.
Now I can move on to the "Shocker Cube" with nothing weighing on my mind.
Leave this Cube to me. You concentrate on your own research.
That is my intention. Besides, I must deliver those Core Medals as well.
Fuhuhuhu... The power of Regis only keeps growing!!
...Oh, yes. I shall entrust you with that thing.
Come forth!! Ultimate Dopant!!
This is... It evolved successfully...
Indeed, the evolved form of that Dummy Dopant. It's untested in real combat, but it's quite powerful.
Splendid. I'll gladly put it to use! Guhahahahahahaha...!!
...? Something's lying there.
Something like a rusty drill has been left lying on the ground...
Hey, ain't this a drill? Now that's a nice find!
A drill...? It might come in handy for something.
A drill, huh... This could come in handy.
A drill, huh... This could come in handy.
A drill, huh... This could come in handy.
A drill, huh... Interesting. Let's take it back with us.
A drill, huh... This could come in handy.
A drill, huh... This could come in handy.
A drill, huh... This could come in handy.
A drill, huh... This could come in handy.
A drill, huh... This could come in handy.
What is it? You've got something you want to show me?
{8074} and the team handed over the "Broken Zeroliner Drill."
A drill...
Oh... It's the Zeroliner's drill. Which means it's made of Den-Metal, right?
The door is firmly shut.
There's one keyhole on the left and one on the right.
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
That's...!!
Ultraman and Ultraman Ace have been crucified on the crosses!
Brother! Brother Ace!
Ultraman! Ace!
It's Ultraman and Ultraman Ace!!
Ultraman and Ultraman Ace!
Ultraman and Ultraman Ace!
Ultraman and Ultraman Ace!
That's Ultraman and... Ultraman Ace, ain't it!!
Ultraman and Ultraman Ace...
Ultraman and Ultraman Ace...
Ultraman and... Ultraman Ace.
Ultraman and... Ultraman Ace.
Brother Ultraman! And even Ace!
Fuhahahahahahahahaha!!
I'll grant that you did well to make it this far. But can you defeat this one?
But can you defeat this one?
The superhuman from another dimension, built to annihilate the Ultra Warriors. Its name is...
Ace Killer!!
It absorbed the energy of the Ultra Brothers I crucified...
...and made their abilities its own!! Now! Prepare yourselves!!
Hey! What the hell are you doing!! You're gonna get yourselves killed!!
Damn it!! We can't lay a scratch on it!!
It's no use... It's too strong...!!
...!! What incredible power!!
It's no good, Ankh... It's too strong!!
This is bad... We can't win like this!!

notes.note: Unlabelled; a party member (likely Ankh, who led the armory trip) echoing Hikari's 'Spiner'. #0.20-0.21 are Hikari's explanation. Spiner = Ultraseven explosive (Ultra wiki spelling); chikyuu boueigun = Terrestrial Defense Force (TDF, Ultraseven). Subject 'we' restored in #0.21.
Mis-decoded kanji (help vs use); read as the yes/no prompt 'Use the Spiner?'.
Per 0341.bla this row (n=3) is never shown; unlabelled, archaic register = Ikadevil. Same for #0.7 (n=6, Ikadevil, unused). Both translated anyway.

'ijigen choujin' rendered 'superhuman from another dimension', matching the glossary's Yapool title 'the being from another dimension'. Same in 0356 #0.32. 'ano yo okuri' (send to the afterlife) rendered 'send them to hell' to fit two lines.
'reino Core Medal' = the medals Ikadevil grabbed from the Armored Samurai Kaijin (three, story_056), so plural 'those Core Medals'.

Speaker order verified in 0342.bla: Den-O Sword (#0.3), #0.4 unused, Mebius, Zero, Rider 1, RX, W (Philip label), OOO, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00. Identical Japanese -> identical English; subject 'this' restored.
Rows 0343 #0.1-0.4 have mis-decoded kanji (not flagged legacy): 'me' in #0.1, 'broken'/'handed over' in #0.2, ellipses in #0.3/#0.4, 'made of' in #0.4. Meaning inferred from context.
Zeroliner = Zeronos's train (Den-O). 'Den-Metal' romanized from the katakana; not in glossary. The 'made of' reading is a guess from a garbled kanji.
0356 leader-variant order from 0356.bla Pt_Chara_Check runs (ids incl. 12 = Seven): #0.1-0.12 Zero, Mebius, W, Rider 1, OOO, RX, Den-O Sword, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Seven (all identical).

#0.15-0.26 order: Mebius, Zero, Rider 1, W, RX, OOO, Den-O Sword (#0.21 rough), Zeta, Nu, Wing Zero, 00, Seven. Mebius's 'niisan' = 'Brother' (Ultraman) as in earlier slices ('Brother Hikari'). #0.26 Seven's 'Man-niisan' rendered 'Brother Ultraman'.
Per 0356.bla never shown (n=29 skipped); archaic-pronoun alternate of #0.29's second sentence.
'???' = Ace Killer before it is named (#0.33). #0.28 '???' = Yapool's unrevealed laugh.
Ankh, shouting at the struggling party; 'yourselves' (plural) because the whole team is fighting.
#0.40-0.51 order from 0356.bla: Zero, Mebius, Seven, OOO (addresses Ankh, #0.43), Rider 1, W, RX, Den-O Sword, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero. Ace Killer g=n -> 'it'. Subject 'we' restored in #0.40/#0.44.

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader-variant orders for 0342 and 0356 confirmed from the .bla scripts (0356 includes Seven, id 12). 0341 #0.4/#0.7 and 0356 #0.30 are unused per script. Guesses: 0340 #0.1 and 0343 #0.1-0.4 have garbled kanji (meaning inferred). Not in glossary: Spiner, Terrestrial Defense Force, Shocker Cube, Zeroliner, Den-Metal, 'superhuman from another dimension' (Ace Killer's title).
